title: Accounts with owners
statementMd:
For accounts 1 to 6 show the account id, type and the owner's name.

Expected columns: `id`, `type`, `name`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT a.id, a.type, c.name FROM accounts a JOIN customers c ON c.id = a.customer_id WHERE a.id <= 6;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
